reviews.comment: Sarah Rice is an amazing professor! She genuinely cares about her students and knows accounting frontward and backward. She did a really great job of connecting what we learned with current real life situations every class. She is also one of the coolest professors I've ever had. Tests are hard, so go to class and understand her examples!

Rice is amazing! Super sweet professor and really cares about you as a person! Test are difficult so prepare. She likes to do the opposite of her examples so make sure you understand different ways to do one thing. She does curve at the end. Ask questions when you are confused and she will help. Quizzes are take home, and two cases aren't too bad!
